[d1] In the United States, fashion designs are generally not protected under the standard copyright statute, which classifies clothing as functional items, though the Digital Millennium Copyright Act (1998) did establish limited protection for vessel hull designs [d2][d3], and the Copyright Office has noted that certain graphic, textile, or artistic elements on clothing can qualify for copyright protection if they demonstrate a sufficient amount of creativity [d1][d5].
